name: Max Sanford
role: Dickinson watchmaker, jeweler and furniture dealer
bio: Max Sanford of Dickinson advertised in the Cow Boy from August 1886, offering watch repairs by mail and sending rings and jewelry on approval to distant customers with references. He also sold furniture, including rocking chairs and hall racks with mirrors. For Christmas 1886 he announced $400 worth of new silverware, clocks, watches and jewelry and promised same-day shipping on orders sent by postal card.
